blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Fire authorities have successfully contained the blaze that broke out in a residential area in Sitio Mansanitas, Barangay Tisa, Cebu City, early Wednesday afternoon, November 25, 2026. According to initial reports from the Cebu City Fire Office (CCFO), the fire started past noon, quickly prompting responders to raise it to the First Alarm to prevent the flames from spreading further into the densely populated neighborhood. READ: Tisa, Cebu City fire raised to first alarm Firefighters swiftly navigated the area and brought the situation under control following aggressive suppression efforts.
